name: bug
description: PlayGuard does something it should not, or not something it should

name: enhancement
description: Something the phone app or the console can do that PlayGuard cannot yet

name: locked-out
description: A console someone cannot get back into: second-hand, forgotten PIN

name: firmware
description: A firmware or Atmosphère version, supported or not yet

name: needs-console-data
description: Waits on a finding from a real console before any code (see ROADMAP.md)

name: i18n
description: A translation, or a string that needs one

name: documentation
description: README, docs/ or another Markdown file

name: dependencies
description: A pinned action or the borealis submodule moves (Dependabot)

name: good first issue
description: Small and self-contained: a good way into the code

name: help wanted
description: Open to anyone who wants to take it: say so in the issue first

name: duplicate
description: Already reported: the other issue is linked

name: wontfix
description: Out of PlayGuard's scope, or not worth what it costs
